newsitem.title: GERMANY: Kohl invites Turkish prime minister to Bonn.
newsitem.headline: Kohl invites Turkish prime minister to Bonn.

text.p: Chancellor Helmut Kohl has invited Turkey's Prime Minister Necmettin Erbakan to make an official visit to Germany, a government spokesman said on Thursday.
He said no date for the meeting had been set.
Erbakan is modern Turkey's first Islamist leader.
Ankara received a blow to its European Union membership hopes this week when leading European Christian Democrats spoke out against inviting Turkey to join the union at a meeting in Brussels.
